_about: Robert Wodrow (1679-1734), minister of Eastwood: The History of the Sufferings of the Church of Scotland from the Restoration to the Revolution, ed. Robert Burns, with a memoir of the author (Glasgow: Blackie, Fullarton, 1828-1830, 4 vols). Volume numbers read off each title page. Named robert-wodrow so it is not confused with the wodrow-society shelf, which holds the Society's collective volume. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
